title: Host Ledger Bound
statement: For all natural numbers $Q,B,r,A,d,n,T$ such that $T\le B(n+Q+1)^r$, one has $2n+2+T+(n+Q+2+(A(n+Q+1)^d+1))\le (B+A+5)(n+Q+1)^{r+d+1}$.
replaced: For all natural numbers $Q, B, r, A, d, n$ and $T$ with $T \le B(n+Q+1)^r$: the total $2n + 2 + T + (n + Q + 2 + (A(n+Q+1)^d + 1))$ is at most $(B+A+5)(n+Q+1)^{r+d+1}$.
